decisions.reason: Cursor's Nov 13 update on the Oct 29 malicious Claude Code extension incident: root cause was an access key issued to vendor Fireworks that Fireworks exposed; attacker copied coding traces, harvested credentials, reached internal tools, and planted tampered extension versions 2.1.312/2.1.313 on the marketplace cache for about 11 hours, affecting at most 5,000 users. Same incident as the canonical story.

decisions.story_title: D-Link DIR-600L firmware 2.17/2.17b02 critical stack buffer overflow CVE-2026-129353 (CVSS 10.0)
decisions.reason: Critical unauthenticated remote stack-based buffer overflow in D-Link DIR-600L firmware 2.17/2.17b02 (authentication.cgi cgi_main, id/password argument), CVSS 10.0, public exploit code available, no fix yet.

CVE-2026-129353.evidence: OffSeq/VulDB lists exploit maturity POC and public exploit code available for the unauthenticated overflow; no observed in-the-wild campaign reported.
